additional/4/algebra/1/1.title: Sets
outcomes: Understand and apply knowledge of sets to communicate and convey mathematical meaning.
content: - Introduction to sets and basic set notation
- Union, intersection, and complement of sets

additional/4/algebra/1/2.title: Logic
outcomes: Understand and apply basic logic to communicate, convey meaning, and reason.

additional/4/algebra/1/3.title: Real Numbers and Polynomials
outcomes: Understand real numbers and use their properties to solve problems.
content: - Absolute values of real numbers and their properties
- Real numbers in radical form and in exponential form

additional/5/algebra/1/1.title: Complex Numbers
outcomes: Understand complex numbers and use their properties to solve problems.
Find the nth roots of a complex number when n is a counting number greater than 1.
content: - nth roots of complex numbers when n is a counting number greater than 1

additional/4/algebra/2/1.title: Functions
outcomes: Find sums, differences, products, and quotients of functions. Find composite functions and inverse functions.
Use properties of functions to solve problems.
content: - Addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division of functions

additional/4/algebra/2/3.title: Exponential and Logarithmic Functions
outcomes: Understand the features of the graphs of exponential and logarithmic functions and apply that knowledge to solve problems.

additional/5/algebra/2/1.title: Trigonometric Functions
outcomes: Understand trigonometric functions and the features of their graphs, and apply that knowledge to solve problems.

additional/6/algebra/2/1.title: Sequences and Series
outcomes: Determine whether a given sequence converges or diverges.
Find the sum of the first n terms of an arithmetic series or a geometric series.
Find the sum of an infinite series.
Understand and apply knowledge of sequences and series.
content: - Applications of sequences and series to problems involving the value of money and periodic payments

additional/4/algebra/3/1.title: Real Numbers and Polynomials
outcomes: Solve polynomial equations and inequalities in one variable of degree at most four and apply that knowledge to solve problems.
Solve equations and inequalities involving fractions of polynomials in one variable and apply that knowledge to solve problems.
Solve equations and inequalities involving absolute values of polynomials in one variable and apply that knowledge to solve problems.
content: - Equations and inequalities involving fractions of polynomials
- Equations and inequalities involving absolute values of polynomials

additional/4/algebra/3/4.title: Exponential and Logarithmic Functions
outcomes: Solve exponential and logarithmic equations and apply that knowledge to solve problems.

additional/5/algebra/3/1.title: Trigonometric Functions
outcomes: Solve trigonometric equations and apply that knowledge to solve problems.
Use the law of cosines and the law of sines to solve problems.
content: - Law of cosines and law of sines

additional/5/algebra/3/3.title: Matrices
outcomes: Understand what matrices are. Find the results of matrix addition, multiplication of a matrix by a real number, and multiplication of matrices. Find the transpose of a matrix and the determinant of an n × n matrix when n is a counting number no greater than 3.
Find the inverse of a 2 × 2 matrix.
Solve systems of linear equations using inverse matrices and row operations.
content: - Matrix addition, multiplication of a matrix by a real number, and multiplication of matrices
- Solving systems of linear equations using matrices

additional/5/algebra/3/6.title: Complex Numbers
outcomes: Solve polynomial equations in one variable of degree at most four with integer coefficients and apply that knowledge to solve problems.

additional/4/geometry/1/1.title: Analytic Geometry
outcomes: Understand and apply knowledge of analytic geometry to solve problems.

additional/5/geometry/2/1.title: Vectors in Three Dimensions
outcomes: Find the results of vector addition, vector subtraction, and multiplication of a vector by a scalar. Find scalar products and vector products.
Apply knowledge of vectors in three dimensions to solve problems.
content: - Vector addition, vector subtraction, and multiplication of a vector by a scalar

additional/5/statistics/1/1.title: Basic Counting Principles
outcomes: Understand and use the addition and multiplication principles, permutations, and combinations to solve problems.
content: o Circular permutations of distinct objects

additional/5/statistics/1/2.title: Probability
outcomes: Find probabilities and apply knowledge of probability.

additional/6/statistics/1/1.title: Introduction to Probability Distributions
outcomes: Find probabilities of events involving random variables with uniform, binomial, or normal distributions and apply that knowledge to solve problems.

additional/6/calculus/1/1.title: Introduction to Calculus
outcomes: Determine whether a given function is continuous.
Find derivatives of given algebraic functions and use them to solve problems.
Find indefinite and definite integrals of given algebraic functions and use them to solve problems.
